title: Do the stingray shuffle!
description:
Shuffle those feet! 👣

In this video, a City of San Diego lifeguard shows us how to do the stingray shuffle. This one move could prevent you from being stung. If you ever need assistance, our lifeguards are always here to help. 

Stay safe and enjoy our beaches!💙🌊
